# Geometry

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Geometry`](gmeow-Geometry.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Geometry>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The spatial extent of a place — a point, line, or polygon — carrying a Well-Known Text (WKT) serialization for shapes richer than a single point (the GeoSPARQL [geo:Geometry](http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Geometry) superset).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)
